portInfo.description: Galveston Wharves markets itself as the only cruise homeport in Texas and a major Gulf embarkation point for Caribbean itineraries. The facilities page documents four cruise piers with berth lengths and terminal floor areas: Pier 10 (1,343 ft berth), Pier 16 (1,203 ft berth), Pier 25 (1,000 ft), and Pier 27/28 Cruise Terminal 2 (1,000+ ft). A 7 Nov 2025 port press release announces the opening of the fourth terminal (Terminal 16) with MSC Seascape as first homeport ship and projects 445 sailings / about 3.9–4 million passenger movements for 2026. March 2026 Wharves brochure restates four cruise terminals totaling 715,000 sq ft and 45-minute sailing time to open water. Passenger door street addresses and WGS84 entrance pins were not found on the pages reviewed — pins remain null.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: The Strand Historic District — shops/restaurants near the port commercial area — ~120 min.
Seawall Boulevard / beach — transfer minutes Not verified.
Texas Seaport Museum / Elissa — tourist piers 19–22 area listed on facilities page — hours Not verified.
Pleasure Pier — evening option with overnight buffer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask your driver for the named cruise terminal / pier number (10, 16, 25, or 27/28). Galveston is not interchangeable with Houston container gates.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Airports. March 2026 brochure states two major international airports within about 1.5 hours; named airports and timed routes Not verified on that brochure excerpt. Parking. Port parking page: online reservations, economy outdoor and garage options, lots within walking distance of each terminal, ADA spaces first-come, Port Police patrol. Rideshare. Brochure cites Lyft/Uber curbside drop-off/pickup. Houston Ship Channel confusion. Galveston Island cruise piers are not Port Houston Bayport — keep itineraries and rideshare destinations labeled Galveston Wharves.
